notes.title: Endless Bosses and Leaderboards Update!
notes.content:
It's finally here!

Players now have the option to compete in leaderboards with their friends and globally! Let's see who can deal a ton of damage to these Bosses before dying!

Bosses will deal more damage as the fight progresses. So be careful! Eventually small mistakes will have a HUGE impact.

Let us know what you think and keep suggestions coming! either here, or on twitter! I mega appreciate any constructive feedback!

Thanks for the interest in the game! I hope you enjoy this update :)
